text: Observe any meetings of people, and you will always find their eagerness and impetuosity rise or fall in proportion to their numbers: when the numbers are very great, all sense and reason seem to subside, and one sudden frenzy to seize on all, even the coolest of them.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter L, to his son, London, September 13, Old Style 1748
